shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, a weekly pet market podium, a world-incident + notoriety/infamy layer (Karma & Reputation integration), Tales at story milestones, Ideology + Biotech integration, procedural blackmail photos, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment

C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive).

## Workflow rule (global)
Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\<About name>\<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>\`. D: = /d in git-bash.

## EXPANSION ROADMAP (user-approved 10-idea list, phases A-E)
- **A (DONE):** #7 notoriety/Karma-reputation + #1 Tales.
- **B (DONE):** #2 per-pawn chronicle + #3 owner death & legacy.
- **C (DONE):** #4 nemesis arc + #6 blackmail.
- **D (DONE):** #8 Ideology rituals + #5 interactive training.
- **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs (Bodyguard=Melee, Handler=Social, Courtesan=Sex-skill w/ Sexperience, hediff fallback without VSE) + #9 Hospitality integration.

## Target selection & attraction (HarassmentEngine.cs)
`TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness) then `FindTarget` builds a victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (now public):** absolute opposite-sex override (enforceOppositeSex/heterosexualOnly), downed-hostile opportunism ignores orientation, else RJW discrete orientation (asexual/hetero/homo/bi/pan). **Approach re-validates sex:** `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks `IsAttracted` continuously during the walk (global FailOn) AND at arrival (backstop before the verbal/escalation stage) so a mid-walk sex change (surgery/gene/RJW sex-change) aborts the harassment instead of proceeding against the now-mismatched sex. Player-directed (`job.playerForced`) grope/force bypasses the re-check.

## Interactive training (Phase D - #5 - Window_TrainingSession.cs)
Setting `interactiveTraining` (default ON): the Command deck **Discipline** button opens a read-the-pet minigame instead of firing StartDiscipline (auto-discipline/scheduled train stay immediate). 3 rounds: pet is in a hidden state (Defiant/Fearful/Yearning) leaked by a "tell"; owner picks Firm/Gentle/Degrade. Correct match (Defiant->Firm, Fearful->Gentle, Yearning->Degrade) deepens conditioning + lowers subDom; misread piles trauma + hardens willpower + costs rapport. State weights from disposition (subDom/willpower/trauma + Masochist/Cumslut/Exhibitionist). Applies accumulated deltas via prof.ApplyCond + AttrDelta on finish, logs a chronicle line + a x/3 message. forcePause window, ModernStyle chrome.

## Ideology rituals (Phase D - #8 - Ideology/Defs/Rituals_Harassment.xml + RitualOutcomeWorker_Ownership.cs + HarassmentEngine.Rituals.cs)
Two optional rites gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme** via `associatedMemes`: **collaring ceremony** (RJWSH_Rite_Collaring) + **devotion parade** (RJWSH_Rite_Parade). Design chosen to dodge the ritual NRE traps (see ideology lore): PLAYER-initiated (canStartAnytime, GatheringSpotOrAltar target - never code-started, so no FillPawns/forced-speaker traps); ROLE-LESS gather-party behavior (RJWSH_OwnershipRiteBehavior, one Party stage - no speaker role = no speech NRE); outcome worker **subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality** (inherits real comps + outcomeChances = no minimal-outcome NRE). Worker `RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_RJWSHOwnership.Apply` calls base then `HarassmentEngine.ApplyOwnershipRiteOutcome(map, quality, parade)`: quality-scaled conditioning surge (Lerp 2->12 collaring / 1->8 parade) on all collared/owned pets on the map, subDom down, trauma down (rite) or up + humiliation + infamy (parade), chronicle each. Participant mood via 3 outcome memories (RJWSH_RiteBotched/Solemn/Exalted). **UNTESTED IN-GAME - rituals are the highest-risk surface; verify the precept appears in the ideo editor under the Ownership meme + a rite completes cleanly.**

## Tales (Phase A - TaleHelper.cs + Defs/TaleDefs/Tales_RJWSH.xml)
Vanilla art immortalizes milestones. `TaleHelper.Record(defName, args)` null-guarded. Six TaleDefs: Collared, BrokenIn, Devoted (PermanentHistorical), Paraded, ScandalPhoto, SoldPet.

## Chronicle - per-pawn life story (Phase B - #2)
`ChronicleEntry.cs` (tick/text/kind: 0 neutral,1 dark,2 bright,3 world). `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100). `HarassmentEngine.Chronicle(pawn,text,kind)` in .Legacy.cs. Recorded at collar/milestones/parade/sale/scandal/owner-death/freed/nemesis/blackmail/training/rites. **Command deck History tab** (DrawChronicle) between Graph and Profile in both CtxTabs arrays.

## Owner death & legacy (Phase B - #3 - HarassmentEngine.Legacy.cs + Patch_OwnerDeath.cs)
Harmony Postfix on `Pawn.Kill` -> `OnOwnerDied`. Pets react by BreakStage: Devoted+ grief (RJWSH_OwnerDied -18/20d, Broken 40% grief-Berserk); Wavering- (non-AI) hypnosis -20 + 50% shed collar (RJWSH_FreedByDeath); Compliant minor. Survivors still collared -> PickHeir (dead owner's colonist lover, else StrongestOrLeader). Consolidated letter.

## Nemesis arc (Phase C - #4 - HarassmentEngine.Nemesis.cs)
`Nemesis` record on GameComponent.nemeses. RegisterNemesis at RescueRaidTick (rescued) + DepthSellPet (sold, x0.6 grudge). Grudge = clamp(100 - hypnosisLevel,10,100). NemesisTick (MTB from GameComponentTick) returns a >~5-day-old nemesis on MTB Lerp(24d,6d,grudge/100) via personalized SpawnAssaultRaid naming pawn + former owner. Debug: "Nemesis: selected returns as a raid".

## Blackmail (Phase C - #6 - HarassmentEngine.Blackmail.cs)
Photo gizmo "Blackmail" -> OpenBlackmailMenu (faction picker, demand + comply%). Demand 250 + beauty*80 + collared 150 + kin/leader 200. Chance 0.6 +0.15 fresh -0.25 hostile. PAID -> silver pod + goodwill -4; REFUSED -> goodwill -10 + 30% punitive SpawnAssaultRaid + infamy. Always marks photo distributed + circulating + notoriety.

## Shared raid helpers (Phase C - HarassmentEngine.Nemesis.cs)
**SpawnAssaultRaid(map, faction, points, ringleader, label, text)**: RCellFinder edge, PawnGroupMakerUtility Combat backup, optional re-factioned ringleader, LordJob_AssaultColony lord, ThreatBig letter. **PickRaidFaction(preferred)**: pawn's hostile faction / any hostile / force-hostile a neutral. Used by nemesis + blackmail-refusal + rituals-adjacent.

## Notoriety x Karma & Reputation (Phase A - ReputationBridge in Bridges.cs)
Karma reputation axis is SIGNED (-1000 infamous..+1000 renowned). Reflection bridge to ReputationAPI. **AddNotoriety(amt, reason)** = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy. Reasons (labels in Karma KarmaReasons): rjwsh_notoriety/scandal_photo(-12)/photo_auction(-8)/parade(-4 owner)/pet_sold(-6 owner)/public_depravity/blackmail. **World-incident pacing scales with colony regard:** <=-250 x0.6, <=-750 x0.4, >=+250 x1.4 (ScandalLeak/RivalSlaver/RescueRaid + NemesisTick). No-ops without Karma.

## Harem window (Window_Harem.cs) - "Command deck" (Concept 3)
FLOATING Window (~1200x800, Modern Suite, accent-LEFT tabs). Left roster (244px) + center STAGE (DrawStageDoll + hotspots + equipment strip Collar/Tailor/Stylist/Photos) / MARKET PODIUM + right OPS (Commands 7 actions[Discipline now opens training session]+6 toggles, Schedule, **Context tabs: Feed/Graph/History/[Profile]/Social**) + COLONY OPS (market + Photos gallery + events + notoriety bar). Measured TinyH/SmallH; "Use tiny text" OFF; DrawBoxSolid explicit color.

## Photos
CompScandalousPhoto gizmos: Auction / **Blackmail** / Destroy. DrawPhotoGallery gathers physical + circulating. Sold-off photos get a real Faction.

## Pet market (weekly) / Conditioning / Break stages
GameComponent.market weekly; BuyMarketPawn -> collar to StrongestOrLeader. Collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility); milestones record Tales+Chronicle. BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}; DepthOnPetLost = owner grief. Escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis.

## Phase 5 world / Phase 7 DLC
Incidents.cs: ScandalLeak/RivalSlaver/RescueRaid (pacing scales with regard). Ideology/ (gated): MemeDef RJWSH_Ownership + IssueDef RJWSH_Collaring (Approved/Honored/Forbidden) + **rituals (Phase D)**. Biotech/ (gated): Compliant/Willful/Predatory + Submissive/Docile genes; Stockholm etches heritable RJWSH_Gene_Submissive.

## Settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs)
masterEnabled, enableSounds, **interactiveTraining (default ON)**, showControlTab, **showSexualityTab (default OFF)**, hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, etc.

## Conventions
Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. render_svg drops text/tight arcs. ValueTuple ok. **UI = Modern Suite: gray flat buttons, accent 2px LEFT bar, card tabs, measured TinyH/SmallH, flat scrollbar via ModernStyle.PushScroll/PopScroll, DrawBoxSolid explicit color.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment) auto-discovers [HarmonyPatch] classes. Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY (see ideology lore for the NRE traps avoided). Raid spawning: SpawnAssaultRaid/PickRaidFaction. **Attraction/sex gate = HarassmentEngine.IsAttracted (public); the approach (JobDriver_Harass) re-checks it during the walk + at arrival so a mid-approach sex change aborts.** Test companions: astryl.KarmaReputation, astryl.ModernBioTab, rjw.quirks, rjw.sexperience, Vegapnk.rjw.genes, TRIBeagle.simpleslaverycollars, Mlie.BondageBedTorture (+ Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology).
